_about: Richmond Progressive Alliance. Its site (richmondprogressivealliance.net) publishes no slate; the mayoral endorsement is from Richmondside's report of the RPA's endorsement vote. Add positions only from the RPA's own published list or equivalent reporting.

entries.note: Jiménez is an RPA member; the RPA voted to endorse Jiménez as its sole mayoral candidate (Richmondside).
